summary: Seven preseason games were played. Detroit's 128-106 win at Minnesota was the largest margin of the night, and Chicago built the biggest lead, 34 points, on the way to beating Milwaukee 125-104. New Orleans' 101-97 win at Dallas was the closest game, and Michael Porter Jr. scored 27 for Brooklyn, the most on the night, in a loss at Miami.

games.headline: Heat pull away from Nets in the third, win 144-128
games.story: Miami led 35-29 after the first quarter and 69-66 at halftime, and Brooklyn never led by more than one point. The Heat last trailed at 84-83 in the third quarter, outscored the Nets 43-37 in that period and led 112-103 going into the fourth. Miami's largest lead was 17. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 20 points, 15 rebounds, 9 assists and 3 blocks in about 24 minutes, and Michael Porter Jr. scored 27 points for Brooklyn.

games.headline: Celtics beat Hornets 114-93, forcing 29 turnovers
games.story: Boston went ahead for good at 8-7 in the first quarter and led 54-44 at halftime and 85-77 after three. The Celtics' largest lead was 23, while Charlotte never led by more than three. The Hornets turned the ball over 29 times to Boston's 10. Jayson Tatum had 19 points, 8 rebounds and 6 assists, Derrick White added 17 points and 4 steals, and Payton Pritchard had 11 assists, while Brandon Miller and Tidjane Salaün scored 16 each for Charlotte.

games.headline: Pelicans hold on to beat Mavericks 101-97
games.story: New Orleans went ahead for good at 17-16 late in the first quarter and led 56-45 at halftime and 75-63 after three. Dallas outscored the Pelicans 34-26 in the fourth quarter and got within three, 100-97, with eight seconds left. Jeremiah Fears led New Orleans with 16 points, 5 assists and 3 steals, and Yves Missi had 9 rebounds and 4 blocks. Dallas was without Cooper Flagg and Kyrie Irving, who were listed as inactive for rest, and Tobi Lawal and John Poulakidas scored 16 each for the Mavericks.

games.headline: Bulls build a 34-point lead, beat Bucks 125-104
games.story: Chicago took the lead for good at 12-10 in the first quarter and led 62-39 at halftime, after a 38-point second quarter. The Bulls' lead reached 34, and Milwaukee's largest lead was one point. Chicago made 20 of 50 threes to the Bucks' 10 of 43, and Milwaukee had 30 turnovers. Matas Buzelis scored 19 points with five threes, Leonard Miller added 18 points and 7 rebounds, and Kam Jones led Milwaukee with 23 points.

games.headline: Pistons rally to beat Timberwolves 128-106
games.story: Minnesota won the first quarter 38-29, but Detroit outscored it 36-20 in the second and went ahead for good at 57-56 late in the half. The Pistons led 97-82 after three quarters and by as many as 26. Jalen Duren scored 24 points on 8-of-9 shooting, plus 8-of-8 at the line, in 15 minutes, and Cade Cunningham had 14 points and 9 assists. Anthony Edwards led Minnesota with 20 points, and the Timberwolves shot 29 of 76 from the field.

games.headline: Spurs take over in the second quarter, beat Suns 123-103
games.story: Phoenix led 23-22 after one quarter, but San Antonio won the second 38-26 and went ahead for good at 46-45 late in the half. The Spurs led 92-75 after three quarters and by as many as 25. They made 30 of 35 free throws, including 14 of 15 by Stephon Castle, while Phoenix made 7 of 31 threes. Victor Wembanyama had 19 points, 5 rebounds and 4 blocks in 23 minutes.

games.headline: Clippers pull away in the third, beat Nuggets 122-110
games.story: Denver led 21-6 early in the first quarter, but the game was tied 24-24 after one, and Los Angeles took the lead for good at 43-42 in the second. The Clippers outscored the Nuggets 38-26 in the third quarter and led 96-81 going into the fourth. Los Angeles had 35 assists on 45 made field goals and only 11 turnovers. Trevon Brazile led Denver with 22 points on 8-of-10 shooting, and Rui Hachimura had 16 for the Clippers.
